content: Lanoxin (digoxin) tablets are used in pediatric patients for the management of heart failure. The indications and dosages are as follows: Loading Dose: For children aged 5 to 10 years: The recommended loading dose is 20 to 45 micrograms per kilogram of body weight. Administer half of the total calculated loading dose initially. Then, administer one-quarter of the loading dose every 6 to 8 hours for two additional doses. For children aged 10 years and older: The recommended loading dose is 10 to 15 micrograms per kilogram of body weight. Administer half of the total calculated loading dose initially. Then, administer one-quarter of the loading dose every 6 to 8 hours for two additional doses. Maintenance Dose: For children aged 2 to 5 years: The recommended maintenance dose is 10 to 15 micrograms per kilogram per day. For children aged 5 to 10 years: The recommended maintenance dose is 7 to 10 micrograms per kilogram per day. Additionally, a daily dose of 375 milligrams orally (PO) may be administered, either as monotherapy or in combination with verapamil.
